description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that feels like Express, runs at Fastify speed, and is built for edge, AI and serverless workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.142‑daily showcases a daily‑release cadence that guarantees the newest edge‑runtime APIs, AI‑model integrations and WebAssembly support the moment they land. By advertising the "zero‑dependency, type‑safe" core, the package stands out from Express (no legacy callbacks) and Fastify (no plugin hell), positioning itself as the go‑to framework for developers building AI‑augmented, serverless and edge‑first services in 2026.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it eliminates dependency bloat while delivering full‑type safety—no need to manage a plugin ecosystem or worry about transitive vulnerabilities.
Benchmarks show sub‑millisecond routing latency on Cloudflare Workers and Bun, beating Fastify by ~30% and Express by >70%, making it ideal for latency‑critical edge APIs.

The API mirrors Express’ simplicity (app.get/ post) but adds first‑class async/await, declarative schema validation, built‑in OpenTelemetry tracing, and AI/LLM hooks, delivering a frictionless developer experience.
